description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for all staff. On an authorised exercise at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional haulier, you first make the calls anyone would under a Friday deadline with a slow file share, then see, six months on, where each shortcut led. Then you sort a short set of found sticks and shortcut messages and match each to the approved way. Only the sort is scored, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
